name: kerryback-public
description: Public plugins: a reviewer for work Claude produced, and a narrated-video builder for slide decks.

plugins.name: critique
plugins.description: Critique work Claude produced and say what to do about it. Parallel reviewer agents -- correctness traced back to the files that produced each number, clarity, and a devil's advocate that reads the code -- then Claude argues against its own reviewers and publishes an HTML guide that leads with the verdict and lays out the paths forward. Heavyweight: it fans out multiple subagents.

plugins.name: voiceover
plugins.description: Turn a slide deck into a narrated MP4 video plus a transcript. Give it the PDF of your slides and Claude writes the narration; a local app shows each slide beside its script, where you edit it, pick an ElevenLabs voice, and generate. The MP4 and transcript are saved to your working directory.
